paras: The Mount Augustus spiny-tailed gecko (Strophurus wilsoni), also known commonly as the Mount Augustus striped gecko and Wilson's spiny-tailed gecko,  is a species of lizard in the family Diplodactylidae. The species is endemic to Australia.
The specific name, wilsoni, is in honor of Australian herpetologist Stephen Karl "Steve" Wilson.
S. wilsoni is found in western Western Australia.
The natural habitat of S. wilsoni is shrubland.
